acceptance.sketch: Turn ortho on, draw a line toward a diagonal cursor and assert it is horizontal or vertical; type explicit coordinates and assert ortho is ignored.

notes: Added from help page "About Orthogonal Locking (Ortho Mode)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Direct distance entry must let users give a direction with the cursor and type a distance to specify points, with QuickCalc and CAL available for computed values.

source.ref: About Specifying Distances, Lengths, and Angles

acceptance.sketch: Start LINE, pick a point, move the cursor right, type 10 and assert the next point is 10 units to the right.

notes: Added from help page "About Specifying Distances, Lengths, and Angles"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Object snaps must work in 3D using the object's real Z value by default, with OSNAPZ projecting snaps onto the UCS XY plane or an ELEV plane.

acceptance.sketch: With OSNAPZ=1 snap to the endpoint of a line at Z=5 and assert the picked point has Z equal to the current elevation.

notes: Added from help page "About Using Object Snaps in 3D"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must support selecting objects one at a time with the pickbox at the Select Objects prompt, preview highlighting, cycling through overlapping objects with Shift+Spacebar, and removing objects from the selection.

acceptance.sketch: Place two lines and a circle under the pickbox, press Shift+Spacebar repeatedly and assert selection cycles through all three; shift-click a selected object and assert it is removed.

notes: Added from help page "About Selecting Objects Individually"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must support window selection (left-to-right, fully enclosed) and crossing selection (right-to-left, enclosed or crossed), plus the other multi-object selection options at the Select Objects prompt.

acceptance.sketch: Drag left-to-right around a rectangle partly containing a line and assert it is not selected; drag right-to-left over the same area and assert it is selected.

notes: Added from help page "About Selecting Multiple Objects"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must support object snaps on underlay geometry toggled independently of regular object snaps by DWFOSNAP, PDFOSNAP, DGNOSNAP and UOSNAP or the shortcut menu, with the understanding that raster-based or oddly built PDFs may yield no or nonstandard snap points.

source.ref: About Using Object Snaps With Underlays

acceptance.sketch: Attach a vector PDF underlay, enable PDFOSNAP, hover an endpoint and assert a snap marker appears; turn PDFOSNAP off and assert snapping is absent.

notes: Added from help page "About Using Object Snaps With Underlays"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.
